lesson.introText: Today, we’ll talk about Japan. We’ll take a look at Japanese food, traditions and culture.

warmup.question: How well do you know Japanese culture?
modelAnswers: I don’t know a lot about it.
I know it very well.
Actually, I only know (origami).

warmup.question: Would you like to visit Japan?
modelAnswers: Sure, it’d be amazing!
Actually, I’d like to visit…
I don’t think so.

fotos.texto: Japanese food is famous all over the world: sushi, ramen, tempura… Sushi is made with rice and, many times, raw fish.
Origami is the Japanese art of folding paper into shapes, like birds and flowers.
Samurais were the warriors of old Japan, famous for their honor and discipline.
Anime is the Japanese style of animation, loved all over the world.

conversation.question: Do you know Japanese food?
modelAnswers: Sure, I do. I love it!
I know it, but I don’t like it.
I have never tried it.

conversation.question: Do you like to eat raw fish?
modelAnswers: Gosh, no! It’s terrible!
Actually, I like it very much.
I have never tried it.

conversation.question: Do you know how to fold origami?
modelAnswers: Yeah, I know how to fold a (bird).
No, but I’d like to learn.
No, I’m not interested in it.

conversation.question: Are you good at manual skills, such as drawing, painting, etc?
modelAnswers: Not very much. I don’t know how to draw!
Not at all, but I really like (drawing).
Yeah, I’m very good at it.

conversation.question: Would you like to be a samurai?
modelAnswers: Yeah, it must be amazing!
Actually, I don’t think so.

conversation.question: Do you know any anime?
modelAnswers: Sure! I know (Dragon Ball Z).
Actually, I don’t think so.
I know a lot of them!

conversation.question: Which cartoons are/were part of your childhood?
modelAnswers: (Powerpuff Girls) were part of my childhood.

evaluation.question: Did you enjoy talking about Japanese culture?
Which other countries would you like to learn more about? I’d like to know more about... (France).
